items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Let me ask Frog about something.

ctx.x: Let me ask Frog about something. Did you get anything about his brother, Ferdinand? Not so much. Who is your brother Ferdinand? I wanted to know more about him. You mentioned him once. Well, I can tell you. I know he made this record with Papa, my Joan of Fiend. He made it up the On Canal Street at the Decker deal. Well, he can tell you more about it.
We have his address, we'll try to talk to him.
